Who are the Ghost Crew? | Star Wars: Galaxy Guide
Ezra. Hera. Kanan. Sabine. Zeb. C1-10P (Chopper). 

This is the Ghost Crew, a ragtag group of rebels working together to make the galaxy a safer place. Learn all about this found family's adventures, from working alongside Ahsoka Tano, to returning captured Wookiees, to fighting Dath Maul. This is your complete guide to the Spectres' lore in Star Wars: Galaxy Guide.
